name: lokka
description: Interact with Microsoft Graph (Entra) and Azure Resource Management APIs using natural language.
long_description: Lokka lets you use natural language to accomplish things in your Azure and Microsoft 365 tenant through the Microsoft Graph and Azure Resource Management APIs. Supports interactive sign-in, app-only authentication (client secret or certificate), and client-provided access tokens.

tools.name: Lokka-Microsoft
tools.description: A versatile tool to interact with Microsoft APIs including Microsoft Graph (Entra) and Azure Resource Management.

tools.name: set-access-token
tools.description: Set or update the access token for Microsoft Graph authentication when using client-provided token mode.

tools.name: get-auth-status
tools.description: Check the current authentication status and mode of the MCP Server.

tools.name: add-graph-permission
tools.description: Request additional Microsoft Graph permission scopes by performing a fresh interactive sign-in.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Leave blank to use interactive sign-in against the 'common' endpoint.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Microsoft Entra app registration (client) ID. Leave blank to use the built-in Lokka app for interactive sign-in.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret for app-only authentication. Required together with Tenant ID and Client ID for client credentials auth.

certificate_path.title: Certificate path
certificate_path.description: Path to a PEM-encoded certificate for app-only certificate authentication.

certificate_password.title: Certificate password
certificate_password.description: Password for the certificate, if any.

use_certificate.title: Use certificate authentication
use_certificate.description: Enable app-only authentication using the certificate configured above.

use_interactive.title: Force interactive sign-in
use_interactive.description: Force interactive sign-in even if app-only credentials are configured.

use_client_token.title: Use client-provided tokens
use_client_token.description: Start the server expecting the MCP client to supply access tokens via the set-access-token tool.

use_graph_beta.title: Use Microsoft Graph beta endpoint
use_graph_beta.description: Use the Microsoft Graph beta API version by default instead of v1.0.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI used for interactive sign-in. Defaults to http://localhost:3000.
